title: The Meadow Express
description: Approach the rural station, ride moving cargo through the railway, and race out into open country.

signs.text:
The quiet meadow
Find the station beyond the fences

The rural platform
Duck under the station beams

Cargo in motion
Board the cargo truck · watch its rail

Beside the rails
Transfer between the loading roofs

The country express
Carry the tailwind into the final fields
